name: The Floating World
lore: The road climbs from old Edo toward Mount Fuji, past bridges, waterfalls, boats and snow in Hokusai's and Hiroshige's woodblock prints, each one waiting to be dug out a block at a time.
sourceNote: Real public-domain Japanese woodblock prints (ukiyo-e) by Hokusai and Hiroshige, CC0 open access from the Art Institute of Chicago; licence re-read per object by lane C (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/07-floating-world/README.md, picks-full.json: 50 picks, 12 spares, landManifest 62 lines; Sharaku dropped, Peter 10/10). Each file is a crop of the print (srcCrop on its manifest line, information only); 13 of the 50 repainted for readability by lane C (Peter, 2026-10-11; recipe in lane C's edits.json, an edit note on the manifest line and the licence row); converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). The folder keeps lane C's slug (07); as installed it is Land 5 in the factory's numbering (levels 401-450, era 13) and Zen World 6.
eggNote: Eggs on the reused sheets' painted side-quest spur tips (World 1's and World 5's rule; the land has no side quests): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots, each repeat its own pair. Kinds that suit a mountain road and a river: raven, grass, mushrooms on the peaks sheet; fish, reeds, butterfly on the river sheet.

zen.note: v7 lane D: The Floating World plays as Zen World 6 (tools/land.js ... zen writes tools/build-data/levels/zen.json only). Records keep the land factory numbers 401-450 (scratch/state.json seeded {from: 401, sheet0: 54, gal0: 62}: Worlds 1-5 hold 1-50, 201-250, 251-300, 301-350, 351-400; World 5's sheets end at 53); the page shows them on from World 5's last Zen number (main.js zenNum).

profile.note: Zen World 6, casual (v7 lane D, 2026-10-10, trial): World 5 Masterpiece Gallery's profile as it ships (tools/lands/06-masterpiece-gallery/land.json): tags E18/N26/H6/X0 ending on a Hard, light deck features (? cards, linked squads), no locks, no archers, no Extreme, no mystery blocks (Peter, 2026-10-08), gentle moats (always 2 ways in) only on prints that can carry one, careful floor 0.5 every tag, and World 5's deal setting for max-box boards (squads 1.6x, 400 attempts). The 50 are lane C's real CC0 woodblock prints (painting kind, shade on, manifest chroma where lane C set one).

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.

deal.note: World 5's shipped deal setting (tools/land-06-notes.md §2): squads 1.6x the land default ([20, 50] at sizeRef 1400, scaled with the board as ever) and 400 deal attempts a candidate (96 before). Kept for the woodblock prints, which are max-box boards too; see tools/land-07-notes.md for the trial.

424.note: fw055 Fudo Falls: at the land's 1.6x squads its fast tapper beats patient play on every candidate (56 tried, --extra 48 --reuse); the land-config default squads [20, 50] (attempts stay 400) pass first time (lane D, 2026-10-11)

map.note: v7 lever 1: no new image bytes. The castle's sheets 7 (The Ironhollows: misty peaks and pines, the road to the mountain) and 1 (The Greenmarch: a river with two bridges and a cottage) reused through map.fromLayout, alternately mirrored, under a woodblock tint (map.tint on every entry: the greens shifted toward Prussian blue and pale paper, the water indigo), clearly apart from World 5's warm sepia. Not 2/5 (World 5's) or 4/6 (earmarked for Water Lily Isle).
